title: Async/Await: Sequential vs Concurrent Task Execution
description: Async functions use await to pause at sleep points. Sequential awaits one after another, concurrent uses gather to overlap waits.

steps.description: fetch is an async function that prints start, awaits a sleep, prints done, and returns a result string.
sequential awaits fetch A then fetch B, measuring total elapsed time. Each await pauses until complete.
concurrent uses asyncio.gather to await both fetches together, allowing their wait times to overlap.
main runs sequential and concurrent, printing elapsed times and results for each.

steps.question: What is the elapsed time for sequential compared to concurrent

steps.description: Running prints sequential with elapsed ~0.60s showing A then B, and concurrent with elapsed ~0.30s showing both start and finish together.
